releaseNotes:
• Persistent Language Reopen: Closing and reopening the keyboard from Emoji, Stickers, or Symbols panels now always directly restores your last used typing mode (Sinhala or English)
• 2-3 Word Multi-Line Die-Cut Stickers: Smart balanced vertical stacking for 2-3 word phrases across 24+ artistic sticker themes
• Quick 2-3 Word Phrase Ribbon: Instant 1-tap generation of popular Sinhala & English phrases in dozens of creative styles
